project_intent.name: Tool Auto Sub
project_intent.purpose: Create dialogue-subtitle videos from local media through a local Windows workflow.
project_intent.intended_use: Single users process local video into source and optional translated subtitle tracks, then preview or export the result.
project_intent.success_definition: The supported local workflow produces inspectable subtitle and preview/export artifacts while preserving source-media and provider boundaries.
project_intent.non_goals: Cloud publication, paid providers, automatic deletion of user media, and changes to AutoSub product behavior during control-plane adoption.
project_intent.constraints: Windows-first local operation; preserve user media; keep provider calls disabled by default; do not commit runtimes, models, caches, or secrets.

project_lifecycle.testing_strategy: Use focused tests for changed behavior and the full pytest suite only after the documented storage preflight; documentation-only control-plane work runs the canonical documentation validator.
project_lifecycle.engineering_conventions: Keep the FastAPI modular monolith, local-only provider boundaries, SQLite project isolation, and explicit runtime readiness/error handling; keep product code separate from Build OS control artifacts.

safety_boundaries.runtime: Windows x64 local application and machine-local runtimes only; no global PATH, service, or shell-handler changes are part of ordinary work.
safety_boundaries.production: No production deployment or cloud publication is enabled; release packaging and external beta activity require separately authorized work.
safety_boundaries.data: User-selected source media and project data remain local; source media is not mutated and low disk space never authorizes automatic deletion.
safety_boundaries.secrets: Do not commit secrets, API keys, tokens, browser profiles, user media, runtime binaries, models, or caches.
